title: CORMA: Constraint-Routed Decision Mamba for Generalizable Multi-Constraint Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34208v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline safe reinforcement learning (RL) learns safety-aware policies from static datasets while satisfying safety constraints during deployment. Motivated by the strong trajectorymodeling capabilities of Transformers, recent Decision Transformer (DT)-based methods formulate offline safe RL as conditional sequence modeling by conditioning action generation on return-to-go (RTG) and cost-to-go (CTG) tokens, thereby enabling adaptation to varying safety budgets. However, existing DT-based methods are developed for single-constraint tasks. For tasks with multiple constraints, generalizing learned policies to unseen combinations of safety budgets remains challenging due to the conflicting requirements imposed by heterogeneous constraints. Moreover, the quadratic complexity of Transformer architectures significantly increases the computational overhead in multi-constraint tasks, as representing additional constraints requires more CTG token

translated_title: CORMA：面向可泛化多约束离线安全强化学习的约束路由决策Mamba
translated_abstract: 离线安全强化学习（RL）旨在从静态数据集中学习具有安全意识的策略，并在部署时满足安全约束。受Transformer强大轨迹建模能力的启发，近期基于决策Transformer（DT）的方法将离线安全强化学习构建为条件序列建模问题，通过以回报-to-go（RTG）和代价-to-go（CTG）标记为条件来生成动作，从而使策略能够适应不同的安全预算。然而，现有的基于DT的方法是针对单约束任务开发的。对于多约束任务，由于异构约束所带来的相互冲突的需求，将学习到的策略泛化到未见过的安全预算组合仍然具有挑战性。此外，Transformer架构的二次方复杂度显著增加了多约束任务的计算开销，因为表示额外约束需要更多的CTG标记。
tldr: 提出CORMA，一种采用线性复杂度Mamba架构的约束路由决策模型，解决了多约束离线安全强化学习中策略难以泛化到未见约束组合以及Transformer计算开销过高的问题。
en_tdlr: CORMA, a constraint-routed Decision Mamba with linear-complexity sequence modeling, enables generalization to unseen multi-constraint safety budget combinations in offline safe RL while overcoming the quadratic computational overhead of Transformer-based methods.
